name: BuildArena 1.0: language-driven machine construction in Besiege (9 official tasks)

assignment.note: Built per call by h0/h0_call.mjs: the official role system prompt (BuildArena-1.0/prompt.yaml) is placed verbatim into the H0 assignment task; observation, actions (message or one official tool call) and evaluation texts are fixed there.

tool.name: submit_action
tool.description: Submit one message or one official tool call.

contract: One action per turn: a message or one official tool call.

player.systemPrompt: interface/prompt.mjs renderFrozenH0(harness, assignment, 'interactive', contract) with the per-role assignment of h0/h0_call.mjs
player.contextPolicy: official AutoGen conversation of the role, in full (no H0 window); BuildArena-1.0/h0_client.py to_h0_turns converts it to H0 turns
player.invalidResponses: Every response is a schema-valid action (structured output). A failed call is retried unchanged up to 20 times (usage-limit errors wait in 5-minute steps up to 4 h); BuildArena-1.0/h0_client.py.

evaluation.metric: official pass rate per task (BuildArena-1.0/analyze/sim_<category>.py); transport is counted at its final (3rd) control generation
evaluation.report: overall, per category and per level (15 episodes each)

environment.adapter: own workflow (official BuildArena 1.0 run_construction / run_simulation + H0 model client)
environment.name: buildarena-1.0
requires: Offline contract validation: no game or mod required.
Native simulation: user-installed Besiege with required DLC and Lua Scripting mod.
Official GUI route: macOS with Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.
Optional Linux x86-64 transport_soft route: system Xvfb, VirtualGL (vglrun), xclip and compatible external observer; see README.md.

data.note: BuildArena @ c3005b9, official-changes.diff and H0 integration are already present in one source tree. The fetch command checks local files only.

notes: The prebuilt control/examples machines of BuildArena 2.0 are not part of 1.0 and are never shown to the Player.

Official code changes are minimal (F1 controller role under agents, F2 starting-block guard id, F3/F4 approval and completion of non-spinning, refined and assembled machines); the diff against c3005b9 is official-changes.diff.

config.py: placeholder API keys only (every role uses the H0 client) and click positions calibrated for a 1470x956-point screen with Besiege windowed at (104,35), 1262x849 pt. Recalibrate on another screen.
